lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aiso har ras baran na saakau gur poorai meree ulat dharee ||1||
lines.translation: Such is the sublime essence of the Lord, that I cannot describe it. The Perfect Guru has turned me away from the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਗਲ ਭਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekhio mohan sabh kai sa(n)ge oon na kaahoo sagal bharee ||
lines.translation: I behold the Fascinating Lord with everyone. No one is without Him - He is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੯੩॥
lines.transliteration: pooran poor rahio kirapaa nidh kahu naanak meree pooree paree ||2||7||93||
lines.translation: The Perfect Lord, the treasure of mercy, is permeating everywhere. Says Nanak, I am fully fulfilled. ||2||7||93||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kiaa kahataa hau kiaa kahataa ||
lines.translation: What does the mind say? What can I say?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaan prabeen thaakur prabh mere tis aagai kiaa kahataa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are wise and all-knowing, O God, my Lord and Master; what can I say to You? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਬੋਲੇ ਕਉ ਤੁਹੀ ਪਛਾਨਹਿ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anabole kau tuhee pachhaanahi jo jeean mahi hotaa ||
lines.translation: You know even what is not said, whatever is in the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਡਹਕਹਿ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: re man kaai kahaa lau dahakahi jau pekhat hee sa(n)g sunataa ||1||
lines.translation: O mind, why do you deceive others? How long will you do this? The Lord is with you; He hears and sees everything. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਓ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso jaan bhae man aanad aan na beeo karataa ||
lines.translation: Knowing this, my mind has become blissful; there is no other Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲਹਤਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੯੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak gur bhae daiaaraa har ra(n)g na kabahoo lahataa ||2||8||94||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has become kind to me; my love for the Lord shall never wear off. ||2||8||94||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਐਸੇ ਹੀ ਝਰਿ ਪਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak aise hee jhar pareeai ||
lines.translation: Thus, the slanderer crumbles away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲਰ ਭੀਤਿ ਗਿਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih neesaanee sunahu tum bhaaee jiu kaalar bheet gireeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This is the distinctive sign - listen, O Siblings of Destiny: he collapses like a wall of sand. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਤਉ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਉਮਾਹੈ ਭਲੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau dekhai chhidr tau ni(n)dak umaahai bhalo dekh dukh bhareeai ||
lines.translation: When the slanderer sees a fault in someone else, he is pleased. Seeing goodness, he is depressed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar chitavai nahee pahuchai buraa chitavat chitavat mareeai ||1||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, he plots, but nothing works. The evil man dies, constantly thinking up evil plans. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਉਠਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak prabhoo bhulaaiaa kaal nerai aaiaa har jan siu baad uthareeai ||
lines.translation: The slanderer forgets God, death approaches him, and he starts to argue with the humble servant of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨਸ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੨॥੯॥੯੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaa raakhaa aap prabh suaamee kiaa maanas bapure kareeai ||2||9||95||
lines.translation: God Himself, the Lord and Master, is Nanak's protector. What can any wretched person do to him? ||2||9||95||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aise kaahe bhool pare ||
lines.translation: Why do you wander in delusion like this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahi karaavahi mookar paavahi pekhat sunat sadaa sa(n)g hare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You act, and incite others to act, and then deny it. The Lord is always with you; He sees and hears everything. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਚ ਬਿਹਾਝਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਛਾਡਨ ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ ਸਾਜਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaach bihaajhan ka(n)chan chhaadan bairee sa(n)g het saajan tiaag khare ||
lines.translation: You purchase glass, and discard gold; you are in love with your enemy, while you renounce your true friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਨੁ ਕਉਰਾ ਅਨਹੋਵਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਜਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hovan kauraa anahovan meethaa bikhiaa mahi lapataai jare ||1||
lines.translation: That which exists, seems bitter; that which does not exist, seems sweet to you. Engrossed in corruption, you are burning away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਭਰਮ ਗੁਬਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh koop mahi pario paraanee bharam gubaar moh ba(n)dh pare ||
lines.translation: The mortal has fallen into the deep, dark pit, and is entangled in the darkness of doubt, and the bondage of emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਹ ਫਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak prabh hot daiaaraa gur bhetai kaadhai baah phare ||2||10||96||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, when God becomes merciful, one meets with the Guru, who takes him by the arm, and lifts him out. ||2||10||96||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਨੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rasanaa har cheenhaa ||
lines.translation: With my mind, body and tongue, I remember the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae ana(n)daa mite a(n)dese sarab sookh mo kau gur deenhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am in ecstasy, and my anxieties are dispelled; the Guru has blessed me with total peace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆਨਪ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਭਈ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaanap te sabh bhaee siaanap prabh meraa daanaa beenaa ||
lines.translation: My ignorance has been totally transformed into wisdom. My God is wise and all-knowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haath dei raakhai apane kau kaahoo na karate kachh kheenaa ||1||
lines.translation: Giving me His Hand, He saved me, and now no one can harm me at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal jaavau darasan saadhoo kai jih prasaad har naam leenaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of the Holy; by their Grace, I contemplate the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਰੋਸੈ ਕਹੂ ਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਛੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak thaakur bhaarosai kahoo na maanio man chheenaa ||2||11||97||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I place my faith in my Lord and Master; within my mind, I do not believe in any other, even for an instant. ||2||11||97||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai meree raakh laee ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has has saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam ride mahi deeno janam janam kee mail gaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He has enshrined the Ambrosial Name of the Lord within my heart, and the filth of countless incarnations has been washed away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਵਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਬੈਰਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nivare doot dusat bairaaee gur poore kaa japiaa jaap ||
lines.translation: The demons and wicked enemies are driven out, by meditating, and chanting the Chant of the Perfect Guru.
